title: Optimal credit portfolio and consumption with regime switching and default contagion
abstract: arXiv:2607.10542v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study an optimal portfolio and consumption problem in a regime-switching multi-name credit market with default contagion. Default events not only generate direct portfolio losses but also alter the default intensities of surviving securities. Under a Cobb-Douglas utility, the homogeneity property reduces the associated Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation to a recursive system of ordinary differential equations indexed by the default states. Solving this system backward from the all-default state, we establish existence and uniqueness of a positive classical solution, characterize the optimal feedback controls, and provide a verification theorem. Finally, numerical experiments present sensitivity analyses and comparisons across contagion settings, regimes, utilities, as well as before and after default.

translated_title: 具有状态切换与违约传染的最优信用组合与消费
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有违约传染的状态切换多主体信用市场中的最优组合与消费问题。违约事件不仅会造成直接的投资组合损失，还会改变存续证券的违约强度。在Cobb-Douglas效用函数下，利用齐次性可将相应的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程化简为以违约状态为索引的常微分方程递归系统。通过从全违约状态出发对该系统进行逆向求解，我们建立了正经典解的存在性与唯一性，刻画了最优反馈控制，并给出了验证定理。最后，数值实验展示了关于传染设定、市场状态、效用函数以及违约前后情形的敏感性分析与比较。
tldr: 本文在具有违约传染的状态切换信用市场中研究最优组合与消费问题，利用Cobb-Douglas效用的齐次性将HJB方程化简为按违约状态索引的常微分方程递归系统，证明了正经典解的存在唯一性并刻画了最优反馈控制。
en_tdlr: This paper studies optimal portfolio and consumption in a regime-switching credit market with default contagion, using the homogeneity of Cobb-Douglas utility to reduce the HJB equation to a recursive system of ODEs indexed by default states, establishing existence and uniqueness of a positive classical solution and characterizing the optimal feedback controls.
